1   IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT INDORE  BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE PREM NARAYAN SINGH  ON THE 15 th OF JULY, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 28800 of 2024  MAHESH  Versus

sentences.text: THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS
Appearance:
(SHRI NILESH MANORE, LEARNED COUNSEL FOR THE PETITIONER ).

(SHRI KAMAL KUMAR TIWARI , LEARNED G.A. FOR STATE)
 ORDER
Heard and perused the record.

This is first bail application filed under Section 483 of the B.N.S.S.,2000, for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.569/2023 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station- Thandla,
District-Jhabua, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act 2012.

The applicant is in custody since 15.6.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is of helping the main accused Deepak who is juvenile and alleged for committing rape.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
The age of the prosecutrix is more than 16 years and 9 months.
As per the statement recorded under section 164 of CrPC of the prosecutrix, main allegation of rape is against the accused Deepak who has already been released on bail by the Juvenile Justice Board.
The applicant is in custody since 15.6.2024.
Conclusion of trial will 2 MCRC-28800-2024 take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6 . Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the rival submissions of the counsel for the parties, custody period of the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
